name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Mitra Yojana
benefit: - **Cost Sharing Support:** Only 50% of the infrastructure development cost will be borne by the concerned farmer or group of farmers. - **Government Grant:** 40% of the cost will be provided directly by the State Government to the power distribution company as a grant.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a landholding farmer/group-farmer.
